source.text_layer: hybrid (CAR narrative p.1-48 text; financial statements scanned)

notes: Hybrid file: the CAR narrative has a text layer, the audited financial statements are scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers; printed note folio + 54 = file page). Units differ: the SCI (p.49) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. No PAA business, no other revenue line. Revenue and expenses from 8.1 (p.94, both years). CSM roll-forward 9.2 p.99 (2568) and p.100 (2567); future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment relating to future service (CSM column); accretion = the profit-or-loss part of the insurance finance row (CSM column). New business 9.3 p.101 (both years). RA release uses 8.1 (16,682 / 14,614), not the AOC RA (18,553 / 16,831). FY2024 is a loss year (onerous charge 287,367). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses + other expenses.
